comment: Skincare routine shown behind the Skincare chip. Steps run in order. Each step needs a name; note and when are optional. 'when' can be 'daily' (default), or a comma-separated list of weekday names in German (Mo, Di, Mi, Do, Fr, Sa, So) for anything that is not every day — retinol twice a week, an exfoliant on Sundays. Editing this file is enough; no rebuild.
